python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0084.png'))
print('Pixel at (400, 450):', img[400, 450])
print('Pixel at (20, 20):', img[20, 20])

# Find blue pixels in right half
jug_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 200) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50)
ys, xs = np.where(jug_mask)
print(f'Bright blue pixels xs: [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], ys: [{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}]')
print(f'Base row of bright blue: {ys.max()}, col center at base: {xs[ys == ys.max()].mean()}')
"
